learning_outcomes.text: Specific applications of the basic knowledge acquired in Theory of Structures
Knowledge and capacity for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.

syllabus_topics: Calculation of Simple and Continuous Beams
1 D.O.F. Systems. Free and Forced Vibrations
Calculation of Structures under Seismic Loads. Response Spectra
Application of the Spanish Seismic-Resistant Building Code
assessment_rules: Attendance at laboratory practices and submission of a final summary report with a minimum grade of 5 are mandatory. For progressive evaluation, a minimum of 4 must be obtained in both partial controls (40% and 30% respectively), in which case no final exam is required. For global ordinary evaluation, students must take a final exam (70%) and obtain a minimum grade of 5, in addition to the practical work (30%) with a minimum grade of 5. The extraordinary evaluation follows the same criteria as the global ordinary evaluation.
